_expectedRedirectsDoc: Routes that legitimately bounce elsewhere, each verified against its own component's
NavigateTo call. A measurement is only valid if it measured the route that was asked
for, so ANY other landing pathname is a gating failure rather than a benign alias.
This list is the whole allowlist: the default is to fail, so a forced redirect nobody
predicted fails loudly instead of quietly filing fiction under the requested route.
Setup.razor (bounces to / once the game is claimed).
_parameterizedDoc: Routes that take parameters, each with the concrete URL(s) the sweep drives. These used to
be a bare list of patterns that the sweep printed and skipped, which left 14 routes outside
the gate — including the two most complex layouts on the branch (the wiki editor and the
layout editor), both of which were overflowing at 390px when a reviewer measured them by
hand. A route nobody measures is a route nobody knows about.
`content` says what a sample actually exercises, because that changes what a clean result
real        — the layout renders in full from the route alone; a clean pass covers the page.
placeholder — the parameter names a record that need not exist in the swept game, so the
sample may render the empty/not-found state instead. Still measured (that
state is a layout too), but it does NOT certify the populated page. Seed the
game and point the sample at real data to upgrade one of these.
An entry with no samples is reported as NOT COVERED, loudly, in the closing summary as well
as the opening one — the quiet one-line skip is what let these routes rot.
